title: Hatching
html:
Rrrrrrumble!

I'd never felt anything like it in my life. The sensation was so overwhelming that I forgot even to say “I am Yoo Joonghyuk” and focused on it.

It felt as though the space and time for dozens of meters around me were kneeling before me. This was what constellations felt.

[Your incarnation body is unfit to express your Status.]

Even though I'd adjusted its level myself, it placed an enormous strain on my incarnation body.

Even though this hadn't been a proper release of my Status to begin with.

[Your Status is temporarily adjusted due to incompatibility with your incarnation body.]

[Your current Status is ‘Historical-grade.’]

An ordinary incarnation body can't withstand Narrative-grade Status.

Even Historical-grade constellations couldn't maintain their Status in symbol form. It went without saying that my ragged incarnation body had no chance.

And yet, it was still this powerful.

“Ghk, ghh, gaaagh……!”

The incarnations around me, clawing at their chests in agony.

Only upon seeing that did I quickly restrict the range of my Status to the ‘marquises.’ Already half on their knees, the marquises looked utterly dazed.

[Someone in the Demon Realm has detected your existence.]

[Someone in the Demon Realm has detected your existence.]

[Someone in the Demon Realm has detected your existence.]

I'd only released my Status for a brief moment, yet no fewer than three messages appeared.

Probably the Demon Kings of nearby Demon Realms.

It didn't matter.

They were going to find out eventually anyway.

Besides, with my Status at this level, they wouldn't know who I was.

[Your incarnation body cannot withstand your Status!]

Sssssss.

The Stories on my back began peeling away.

Fortunately, it was out of their sight, so the marquises hadn't noticed.

“Th-this aura……”

“A constellation!”

Marquis Osteon finally came to his senses and screamed.

Cuarteto beside him was also on the verge of toppling backward.

It was a satisfying sight, but I couldn't drag this out any longer.

[Your incarnation body is beginning to collapse!]

My combat strength isn't particularly high compared to the ‘Status’ I possess.

So I had to finish them off while my Status still had them cowed.

[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Bookmark’!]

Bzzzzzzzt!

But why?

Sparks flew through the air, and the skill was forcibly terminated.

[Your incarnation body is too unstable to use this skill.]

……Goddammit.

Had I rushed things too much?

[You have used power that does not conform to probability!]

[The ‘Exile Penalty’ is accelerating.]

I'd kept fighting recently, so I'd anticipated that this might happen.

But my incarnation body was collapsing much faster than I'd expected.

Releasing a constellation's power must have placed a considerable strain on it.

The marquises seemed to be gradually adapting too, raising their own auras against me.

From the look of it, they possessed either a single Legendary-grade Story or several Historical-grade Stories. They were marquises, after all, so they were probably about as strong as Reinheit of <Paradise>.

“Even a constellation can't kill me inside the scenario!”

They were fairly clever, too.

Sssssst.

Marquis Osteon transformed into an [Executioner] again and drew his scythe on me.

Our only [Fighter], Jang Hayoung, was down.

For now, there was no way to kill him.

The situation took an even worse turn.

“An exile?”

“……Could it be?”

Enough Story fragments must have fallen from my body that the marquises finally noticed.

The skill restrictions prevented me from using [Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint], but it was painfully obvious what they were thinking.

「If only I could get my hands on his Stories……」

Like hyenas hunting a wounded beast, they began cautiously surrounding me.

“Call for reinforcements! All we need to do is stall, and he'll destroy himself.”

The sound of whistles, and signs of [Executioners] approaching from all directions.

More troops must have mobilized; I could sense ominous movements among the nobles over at the [Factory] too.

「Kim Dokja thought.」

To take down marquises, I needed to use at least [Electrification].

「But he couldn't use skills.」

If I stalled any longer, not only my incarnation body but the other citizens would be in danger too.

「He had to kill them some other way, without skills.」

How?

「There was only one way.」

The moment I made up my mind and stepped forward, the approaching Marquis Osteon let out a terrible scream.

“Aaaaaaaagh!”

Pshhhhhht!

Marquis Osteon's arm rolled across the ground. Having transformed into an Executioner, he couldn't be hurt by ordinary attacks. Which meant……

“You shouldn't let your guard down like that.”

When had Jang Hayoung regained consciousness? Standing behind him, Hayoung was grinning like a villain. Given the injuries from earlier, it was an unbelievable recovery.

[The character ‘Jang Hayoung’ is using the skill ‘Immortal Body Lv.7.’]

……Immortal Body?

Wasn't that a Murim super-regeneration skill?

As I approached, Jang Hayoung caught my gaze and muttered as though making an excuse.

“There was someone from Murim among the people I was chatting with earlier……”

I sighed as Jang Hayoung trailed off, looking embarrassed.

Apparently, the Black Flame Dragon hadn't been the only conversation partner.

But if that was Immortal Body, it belonged to the ‘Breaking the Sky Sword Saint’……

“All of you, attack! Kill the Fighter first!”

Marquis Osteon deactivated his [Executioner] form again and shouted to the reinforcements. The nobles who had rushed over began surrounding us along with the four remaining Executioners. Three earls and five barons. Among them was a fellow named Baron Melen, whom I'd seen on the day I first arrived here.

“Over there! Save the Revolutionary-nim!”

Agitated citizens also ran over from a distance to rescue us, but there still weren't enough of them. Jang Hayoung went pale at the sight of the nobles drawing their menacing weapons and asked,

“Any ideas? I can't kill these guys.”

A [Fighter] is the strongest against [Executioners], but vulnerable to every other position. In the end, I had to handle the rest.

“You just deal with the [Executioners].”

I stood in the way of the other nobles targeting Jang Hayoung.

Countless blades and spears flew at me, but I didn't dodge.

[You are currently under the protection of the scenario.]

I was being guarded, so I couldn't die.

I only needed to take them down calmly, one at a time, without pushing myself.

But as if someone had read that thought, a message sounded in the air.

[The ‘Ruler’ has forcibly withdrawn ‘Night.’]

[Ruler].

The position referring to the [Duke], the master of this industrial complex.

[No one died tonight.]

Night had ended, but the fighting continued.

No, it was only just beginning.

[The power of the scenario protecting you disappears.]

“His protection's gone! Kill him!”

“He's got an incredible Story!”

I smiled bitterly at the nobles charging me as though they'd anticipated this.

“You put some thought into that, but it was a mistake.”

With [Night] gone, the [Executioners] couldn't use their power.

And the two marquises, the core of the [Industrial Complex]'s fighting strength, were here.

This was the situation I'd waited so long for.

“Release the Story.”

My incarnation body was too unstable to use skills.

But that didn't mean I had no way to fight.

[You tell the Historical-grade Story ‘Bug Slaughter.’]

In my current state, awakening a Legendary-grade Story or higher was beyond me.

But there was no need to use a ‘Legendary-grade’ Story against the likes of them in the first place.

Rrrrrrrrrrumble!

A Story that made the fullest use of the power of one's ‘Status.’

It was a Story a demon noble named Tentacio had once used in the [Dark Castle].

I blinked slowly, and suddenly the nobles before me seemed to shrink.

[Bug Slaughter], earned by massacring tens of thousands of weaker beings.

The Story became pitifully weak against a stronger opponent, but against weaker ones, it was different.

[You possess absolute power over all beings whose Status is lower than yours.]

[This Story is effective only against beings whose Status is at or below a certain level.]

The approaching nobles turned deathly pale at the terrifying aura seeping from my entire body.

“Th-that's impossible……!”

But it was already too late for regrets.

Crack! Cr-cr-crack!

I didn't even need a sword. I made every muscle in my body swell in an instant, then began beating down all the nobles with nothing but my fists.

“Aaaaaagh!”

It was, quite literally, a ‘slaughter.’

[You have acquired a Historical-grade Story.]

[You have acquired a Historical-grade Story.]

The nobles' Stories fell into my hands one after another.

[Your incarnation body is rapidly collapsing!]

In an instant, I punched holes through the barons' bodies, then grabbed the earls by the hair and burst their heads. With the battle turned on its head in moments, the nobles who had stumbled back turned and began fleeing.

“Run! We can't fight him! Hurry—!”

A few got away. But the important ones didn't.

“Aaaaaagh!”

Cuarteto and Marquis Osteon struggled in my grip as I held them by the backs of their necks. Seeing signs that they were trying to summon their Stories, I didn't hesitate. I smashed their heads together, then pierced their hearts with both hands.

“Guuuuurgh……”

Had they put up a more serious fight, things might have been different.

But the marquises, already broken by my ‘Status,’ died without being able to resist at all.

[You have acquired numerous new Stories!]

[You have killed the demon marquis ‘Cuarteto’!]

[You have killed the demon marquis ‘Osteon’!]

[You have earned a new achievement!]

[Your notoriety spreads through the Demon Realm due to your killing of marquises!]

[The high-ranking nobles of the Demon Realm fear you.]

[You have received 50000 coins as an achievement reward.]

A modest reward, but better than nothing.

I looked around. Jang Hayoung and the other citizens were also bringing things under control. The surviving Executioners and nobles had formed ranks toward the Factory and were slowly retreating.

[Your incarnation body has reached its limit.]

[The Story ‘Bug Slaughter’ is forcibly terminated.]

My vision lurched, and a wave of dizziness hit me.

I shouted at the remnants fleeing toward the [Factory].

“Baron Gilat, Baron Sarabos, Earl Mokba!”

The names of the surviving [Executioners].

Names Han Myungoh had given me beforehand.

Both Jang Hayoung and I were too exhausted now to chase them or fight them anyway.

That was why I called their names.

It was a kind of warning.

I know who every one of you is.

Who you are, and what position you hold.

So you could die at any moment.

Threatened for the first time in their lives, the Executioners trembled.

I continued speaking to them.

“Tell the Duke.”

Enough time must have passed for dawn to begin coloring the Demon Realm's sky. Amid the faintly wavering shadows, I slowly finished speaking.

“Tell him to learn to fear [Day].”

The collapse of my Stories made me feel as though I could fall at any moment, but I held on to consciousness until the remaining nobles had completely vanished toward the Factory.

Someone murmured.

“R-revolution……”

Starting with that, people began crying out for revolution, one after another.

Listening to their voices, I recalled my favorite sentence from the ‘Revolutionary’ arc.

「In the brightening light of dawn, the industrial complex's frozen time was finally flowing again.」

The anger and anguished cries of people who had slept so long in [Night].

They had slept for so long that they hadn't even known such emotions existed. Those emotions were awakening one by one.

“Revolutionary! Revolutionary!”

“Yoo Joonghyuk! Yoo Joonghyuk!”

[Your influence has surpassed that of the ‘true Revolutionary.’]

[You acquire a Story by satisfying the conditions for Story creation.]

[The new Story ‘Silver Screen Revolutionary’ begins!]

What a shame. Bihyung and those constellations should have seen this.

I'd have received a bundle of coins if they had.

Just then, a message sounded as though it had been waiting.

[The ‘Dokkaebi Egg’ responds to your ‘Story.’]

[The ‘Dokkaebi Egg’ begins recording your story.]

The vibrations against my chest seemed to grow stronger. Then, at last, the sound of a message.

[The egg is about to hatch.]

At the cr-cr-crack of the shell splitting, I knew the time had come.

Come to think of it, this stage didn't need another dokkaebi.

The dokkaebi who would tell this stage's story had already been chosen.

[A temporary channel is created in the Demon Realm.]

The Demon Realm scenario was only just beginning.

[The constellation ‘Demon King of Salvation’ has entered the temporary channel.]

Suddenly, I felt as though I could breathe freely. As though someone had kept my mouth taped shut all this time and finally ripped the tape away.

[The constellation ‘Demon King of Salvation’ looks upon the ‘Syswitz Industrial Complex.’]

My vision expanded, and I began seeing things my incarnation body couldn't see.

From above, the [Industrial Complex] resembled an enormous circular dome. A circular city spreading outward from the [Factory] at its center. Every incarnation in that city was looking up at the sky.

“Th-this is……!”

“A channel! A channel's opened!”

Apparently, they too had received the message announcing the temporary channel's opening.

“The dokkaebis are here! Our Demon Realm's finally getting attention too!”

Faces that looked almost overcome with emotion.

It was understandable.

This was where people cast aside by the scenarios gathered.

Incarnations who had once hated constellations and coins had come to the Demon Realm and become the ones who missed them more than anyone.

“Hey! Are you okay? Did you hear that message too?”

With Jang Hayoung supporting me, I barely managed to stand.

[Entering the temporary channel temporarily delays the collapse of your incarnation body.]

I let out a sigh of relief.

A channel is an important mechanism at the heart of a story.

Indeed, simply entering the channel had begun to gradually stabilize the Stories throughout my body.

Of course, I hadn't entirely escaped my lot as an exile…… but this should buy me some time.

[Enter a main scenario to prevent Story collapse.]

In the end, for an exile like me to enter a main scenario, I had to kill the ‘true Revolutionary.’

I tried running my hands over my crumbling arms and legs.

Fortunately, my core Stories still seemed intact. I could find some way to repair the damaged parts.

[The Story damage to your incarnation body is severe.]

[New Stories are required for repairs.]

I hadn't properly checked the list yet, but I had numerous Stories taken from the nobles.

Most were Historical-grade, and I thought there had been a Legendary-grade one among them too.

In any case, I had to act quickly before the temporary channel closed.

I asked Aileen as she approached from a distance.

“What about the injured?”

“……There are more than I expected.”

Aileen's expression was grim. Even a quick glance showed more than several dozen people lying on the ground. Many citizens had suffered life-threatening wounds, and a considerable number looked unlikely to survive the day.

“Dokkaebi Bag.”

At my words, a familiar holographic window appeared in the air.

I couldn't begin to describe how frustrating it had been without this.

This must be how a rich person felt when they had money but couldn't spend it.

After a quick check for any useful items that had come in during my absence, I spent about 30,000 coins on a large quantity of ‘Ellain Forest’s Vital Force.’

“Hand these out to everyone.”

“Th-this is…… How on earth did you get these?”

“Don't ask for the details.”

Aileen accepted the vital force with her eyes wide in surprise.

Of course she was surprised. Ellain Forest’s Vital Force could only be obtained through the ‘Dokkaebi Bag.’ In the Demon Realm, where there were no channels, it was bound to be precious.

[The temporary channel has little time remaining.]

I took out the [Dokkaebi Egg] I'd been holding against my chest. Hairline cracks ran across its surface.

Signs of hatching.

For baby dokkaebis, a temporary channel was something like movement in the womb (胎動).

Breathing practice, so to speak.

Cr-crack.

I gently stroked the egg and felt a faint tremor from inside the shell.

[The ‘Dokkaebi Egg’ will hatch soon!]

[Feed it healthy Stories.]

I quickly took out a few Story fragments and held them to the egg. The egg shivered and let out a little kyurrk.

[The ‘Dokkaebi Egg’ is satisfied.]

[The ‘Dokkaebi Egg’ wants its parent's warmth.]

What a demanding little thing.

Come to think of it, Bihyung had told me something.

—I'm telling you this in case the egg hatches: when it's about to hatch, you have to hold it close.

—What? Why?

—I'm not sure myself. But they say that's how a healthy dokkaebi is born. So we all do it too.

It seemed strange that dokkaebis believed in such superstitions, but on second thought, I wondered whether ‘superstition’ could even exist in this world. A world where every Story became reality.

I looked toward the distant [Factory].

With the two marquises dead, the Syswitz Industrial Complex was now firmly on the path to revolution. I'd broken both its arms and delivered a proper warning at the end, so the [Factory] wouldn't be able to act rashly now.

I couldn't take them on in my current condition anyway…… Well, this should hold them off for a few days.

“Aileen. Seal off the citizens' district now.”

“What?”

“The nobles won't make a move for a while anyway. Let's rest and make some preparations too.”

I spoke as I looked down at the egg, whose movements were growing stronger.

From now on, the [Duke] wasn't the only problem.

Once the channel opened, the real monsters would appear.

Before then, there were a few things I had to prepare.

●

With the others' help, I set up a space inside the clinic where we could maintain the right temperature and humidity. Aileen kept sighing as she examined my condition.

“Don't move for the rest of today. Your body's in an awful state.”

“All right.”

“Don't just brush me off. You really nearly died. I've never seen anyone use five whole Historical-grade Stories for repairs……”

This really wasn't a cost-effective body.

To think I had to plaster it with Stories just to pull through.

Still, it was better than dying.

“It's fine. I still have a Legendary-grade Story.”

I checked the ‘Legendary-grade Story’ I'd acquired by killing one of the marquises earlier.

[You possess the Legendary-grade Story ‘God of the Dice.’]

The Legendary-grade Story ‘God of the Dice.’

For reference, according to ‘Ways of Survival,’ this Story went something like this.

「One of the Stories possessed by the ‘King of Gambling.’ It is said that this Story's owner could choose the number on the first die they rolled.」

Sometimes, I couldn't understand why certain Stories had become ‘Legendary-grade.’ Even if there were differences in Status within that grade, how could a Story like this be on the same level as my ‘King of a Kingless World’……

Aileen spoke with an incredulous expression.

“You're going to use a ‘Legendary-grade’ Story as repair fragments? Do you even know how valuable it is?”

“……”

“No, how on earth have you stayed alive this long? Do you have that ‘blessing of the story’ I've only heard about……?”

The blessing of the story……

That was a greeting the dokkaebis often used.

“Enough nagging. I can't go anywhere today because of this little one anyway.”

I spoke as I stroked the egg held against my chest.

Every plan I had from here on depended on this little one hatching safely.

Jang Hayoung, who had been peering intently at my chest, asked,

“What's that?”

“An egg.”

“An egg? What kind of egg?”

“A dokkaebi egg.”

At my words, Jang Hayoung's eyes widened, along with everyone else's.

“What? Seriously?”

I nodded and looked down at the egg.

Hummm.

Whenever the egg stirred intermittently, the ‘temporary channel’ would open and close again.

[Constellations currently in the channel: 1]

A lonely number for now, but before long, this channel would be packed. I would make sure of it.

“Wait! This is really a dokkaebi egg? You're not joking?”

“Does it look like I'm joking?”

“……Was this little thing the reason the channel opened too?”

“Yes.”

Unlike Jang Hayoung, whose mouth opened and closed wordlessly in bewilderment, Aileen wore a grave expression.

“Wait a moment. If this really is a dokkaebi……”

“I'm just trying to give the Demon Realm a chance too. You can't stay slaves to the industrial complex forever.”

There was a hint of defiance in the way Aileen quietly bit her lip. In truth, she probably knew too. I deliberately put that feeling into words.

“Are you afraid the next scenario will be even worse?”

After a scenario, another scenario always awaited.

A scenario that could be better than this one or even worse, with no way to tell which.

Aileen spoke as though she didn't want to admit it.

“This is a world without a best option.”

“I think you need to consider whether a life spent choosing only an uncertain lesser evil might be even worse.”

“I'm very grateful that you've started a revolution for us. But you……!”

Aileen abruptly stopped there and looked into my eyes. I don't know what she saw or felt in that brief meeting of our gazes.

“……What exactly are you doing all this for?”

She simply asked that.

“Because I want to see the ending of a certain story.”

I answered as I always did.

“Does that…… mean you intend to reach the end of the scenarios?”

“Something like that.”

Then Aileen murmured,

“Seeker of the End……”

“……?”

“I've heard about them from the constellations of my home planet. They said there are constellations who seek the ‘end’ of every story.”

‘Seeker of the End,’ huh.

Come to think of it, there were beings like that in the <Star Stream>.

It wasn't yet time for them to act in earnest, but apparently word of them had already spread on Aileen's home planet.

Whatever she was thinking, Aileen quietly fell silent. Meanwhile, Jang Hayoung spoke.

“But if this one's a ‘dokkaebi’ too, won't it end up like the ones we know?”

“I won't let that happen. Not every dokkaebi becomes the same kind of streamer.”

“True. It's the same with people. But how did you get this egg? I've never heard of even Wenny men having something like this.”

“Well……”

As I hesitated over how to explain, I glanced beside me and saw Han Myungoh looking between me and the egg with a peculiar expression.

“You must have had difficulties you couldn't talk about. Childbirth is painful.”

“……You seem to be misunderstanding something, so let me make this clear: I didn't give birth to it.”

“I understand.”

An uncomfortable sense of solidarity seemed to have formed.

Just as I was about to explain properly that I'd never been cursed by a Demon King.

Tick-tick-tick.

The cracks in the egg widened, and a faint light began leaking out.

[The ‘Dokkaebi Egg’ is about to hatch.]

The moment I'd been waiting for had finally arrived.

[The <Star Stream> watches the birth of a new streamer.]

For that moment, Han Myungoh, Mark, Jang Hayoung, Aileen, and I all looked down at the creature breaking out of its egg with the same feeling. The birth of a life has that kind of wonder to it.

A tiny back slowly appeared between the breaking pieces of shell. Looking at that back covered in pure white down, Jang Hayoung seemed at a loss.

“……I really hate dokkaebis. But seeing one like this feels different.”

But this birth wasn't something to celebrate quite so readily.

The newborn dokkaebi scrunched up its face and cried.

As though its very existence here was painful.

I recalled a line the ‘Dokkaebi King’ had once spoken in ‘Ways of Survival.’

「“Listen, you pitiful beings, given a fate at birth, compelled to live loving ‘stories.’”」

The newly born dokkaebi was crying.

Because it had to be born into a world like this, because even a world like this had stories, and because it had to live loving them.

Yes, I made you this way.

So resent me.

[The baby dokkaebi looks at you.]

[The baby dokkaebi recognizes you as its parent.]

[The baby dokkaebi's soul communes with you.]

And then I heard a voice.

—I've waited a long time, ajusshi.

The flow of space and time was growing strange.

Jang Hayoung's lips moved very slowly, and the voice was so severely fragmented that it no longer sounded normal.

A scene in which the entire world seemed to be moving in slow motion.

「Kim Dokja realized. So this was a ‘dokkaebi's’ time.」

To manage and assess countless channels simultaneously, dokkaebis perceive things far faster than other living beings.

I looked up into the air.

A sphere of pale light floated above the baby dokkaebi, whose fluffy fur had grown in. A sphere I'd seen before. It was Shin Yoosung's soul.

‘It's been a while, Yoosung.’

Translucent light rippled within the sphere, and for a moment, something like a human silhouette appeared.

A being who had crossed distant dimensions with the desire to save the world and out of loyalty to Yoo Joonghyuk.

The Shin Yoosung of the 41st round was before my eyes.

[You have earned an unbelievable achievement!]

[You have become the first human to hold a dokkaebi egg close.]

[You have acquired a new Story!]

[You have acquired the Story ‘Father of a Dokkaebi.’]

As though she'd read my expression, Shin Yoosung spoke.

—Don't apologize. I chose this.

‘I'm still sorry.’

—You were amazing, ajusshi. Even the captain in the 41st round wasn't as good as you.

‘That was just the easy part. There's still a lot left to do.’

—You need my help, right?

I nodded, and Shin Yoosung smiled faintly.

—Will I be able to do it well?

‘You will. I'll help you.’

Only someone who has reached the very bottom of the scenarios knows their weight.

That was why I trusted the Shin Yoosung of the 41st round.

Of course, that wasn't a reason for Shin Yoosung to trust me.

—The captain in the 41st round failed.

Shin Yoosung's voice trembled faintly.

—You'll go through even more terrible things from now on.

‘I'm sure I will.’

—Things you haven't even imagined yet will be waiting for you.

‘You'll be coming with me.’

Shin Yoosung was silent for a moment.

She seemed to be weighing the meaning of my words, or perhaps measuring the depth of the years she'd lived. Either would be painful for her. At last, Shin Yoosung spoke.

—Once I'm fully born, I won't be able to remember you right away, ajusshi.

‘I know.’

—Don't tease me too much if I act stupid.

‘I'll try.’

Her little laugh sounds lovely.

In a silence like soft music, Shin Yoosung continued speaking.

—I have almost no good memories of the scenarios.

Casual words, but sincere precisely because they were casual.

Listening to her, I recalled the stories in ‘Ways of Survival.’

The stories of ‘Shin Yoosung’ that I knew.

Stories that couldn't be fully explained even with a hundred, a thousand more sentences……

—Still, if I have to tell any more stories……

I don't know how long she had to wrestle with herself to say those words.

No matter how much I'd read ‘Ways of Survival,’ even if I could read her inner thoughts with [Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint], I didn't know the time Shin Yoosung of the 41st round had lived through, or the pain she had to bear because of it.

—This time, I'll tell stories for you, ajusshi.

And so all I can offer in response to her answer is my paltry awe.

‘Thank you.’

I bit my lip hard to hide the emotion welling up inside me.

As brightly shining strings of text rose into view, the flow of perceived time gradually returned to normal.

[The first channel in the 73rd Demon Realm has opened.]

[Channel name: #BI-90594]

The fragmented sounds came together again, and I heard Jang Hayoung's voice.

“What are you going to name the baby?”

……I'd wondered what was being said. So that was it.

I'd already given the name a lot of thought.

The baby dokkaebi was looking up at me.

I looked into her eyes and spoke quietly.

[Channel administrator: Biyoo (譬喩)]

Had she heard her name?

The baby dokkaebi reached out to me. When I put my finger in her tiny, down-covered hand, she wriggled it for a moment, then gave me a little smile.

●

Shin Yoosung was crying.

It happened from time to time after they'd escaped the Seoul Dome.

When she fell asleep at the end of an exhausting day, or when she opened her ‘Attributes Window’ and stared blankly at the ‘Constellation Sponsor’ field.

Whether she realized it or not, Shin Yoosung kept finding herself in tears.

And it was always Lee Gilyoung who scolded her for it.

“Hey. Why are you crying again? Dokja-hyung likes people who act mature.”

At those words, Shin Yoosung gave him a small glare with her reddened eyes.

“Get lost!”

“Hyung'll be back soon. You saw it too, right? The goodbye he left me. ‘Let's meet again, Lee Gilyoung.’”

“Ajusshi never said that, you know?”

“He said it to me! I definitely heard him!”

Lee Jihye, who had been listening from behind them, snickered. Lee Gilyoung narrowed his eyes.

“What are you laughing at?”

“You little cutie.”

Shin Yoosung, Lee Gilyoung, and Lee Jihye had defeated the monsters that appeared as disasters in the twelfth scenario and were on their way to the agreed meeting place.

The place where they had agreed to meet the others again was Seongnam.

They'd agreed to reunite around here, so the rest of the group would gather soon too.

While Lee Jihye and Lee Gilyoung bickered, Shin Yoosung opened her Attributes Window.

[Your connection to your constellation sponsor has been severed.]

Ever since she'd left the Seoul Dome, that message had always been displayed in Shin Yoosung's Attributes Window.

Apparently disliking Shin Yoosung's gloomy expression, Lee Gilyoung spoke again.

“Hey, watch this coin.”

“……What is it?”

“If I toss this coin and it comes up heads, Dokja-hyung's alive.”

Shin Yoosung pouted at the 100-won coin Lee Gilyoung took out.

“We already did that before.”

“Still, let's do it again.”

“……What's the point? It's not like ajusshi will come back just because it lands on heads.”

Coin tossing.
